d:
The journey deep into the unforgiving Peruvian Andes continues. Starting from the town of Putina, we are pushing the limits and heading higher into the mountains to explore the isolated gold mining towns of Peru.
Leaving the lower valleys behind, the roads get rougher, the air gets thinner, and the landscape completely transforms into a cold, rugged frontier. This is the gold route.
The History of the Andean Gold Rush
